rows.prompt: Locked-off tripod shot, absolutely zero camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no dolly, framing identical to the start image for all ten seconds. This is a cinemagraph of an architectural interior: every wall, ceiling, joinery panel, piece of furniture and fixture stays perfectly still and unchanged like a photograph. The only motion is natural ambient life. The two white three-blade ceiling fans rotate slowly and steadily at a gentle, constant speed. The tall linen curtain beside the window sways very softly in a light breeze, its hem lifting slightly. Outside the window the trees rustle gently. The band of warm afternoon sunlight across the bed and headboard drifts very slowly sideways, and soft leaf shadows flicker faintly within it. The bed, cushions, throw, lamps, chairs, artwork and TV do not move. Constant exposure, no flicker, photorealistic, crisp architectural detail, nothing new appears in the room.
